method.dependency_environment: Existing Isaac Lab 3.0 dependency environment with frozen runtime source; independent clean installation smoke is outside these rates.
method.clock: Synchronous decisions freeze Newton simulation time; wall latency is recorded separately.
method.hardware: Shared NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4090 with other concurrent experiments; not exclusive timing.
method.arrival: distance <0.2 m and speed <0.3 m/s for 0.5 s
method.collision: Newton contact >1e-6 N or oriented-body box overlap at physics samples including final state
method.tracking: Euclidean position error at 100 Hz against the active reference at the same simulation time
method.motion: Raw baseline report used 100 Hz; checked report uses 400 Hz; this summary recomputes both from pre-integration physics_states plus final state
method.motor: Instantaneous total thrust 8.5*sum(u_i**2) at 100 Hz recorded motor states; not commanded/allocated wrench or the integrated substep mean
method.time_statistics: Pooled per-call percentiles within each group/scene; initial calls included; episode-level replan-only statistics also retained
method.cycle_boundary: Through handoff, excluding subsequent result writes and physics; checked cycle includes trajectory diagnostics, baseline cycle does not
method.initial_map: Complete static scene point cloud fused before flight; subsequent body-mounted LiDAR updates at 2 Hz

limits: Ten episodes per policy on two fixed scenes do not establish arbitrary-map reliability.
Decision wall times are not hidden by synchronous simulation; no real-time claim.
Motion and collision are physical-step samples; flatness checks use 101 samples per trajectory piece.
Motor thrust statistics use 100 Hz endpoints and do not measure all 400 Hz substep peaks.
Optimizer success and execution acceptance are separate; all baseline failures are retained.
No dynamic obstacle, empty-map exploration or asynchronous wall-time execution validation.
